# IFBench official evaluator, pinned and unchanged (Apache-2.0)

Source: [allenai/IFBench](https://github.com/allenai/IFBench), commit `1c40f0c10d9b5c5c2f10a175a28007ebb64f7f4d`, maintained by Allen Institute for AI. Vendored source `ifbench/*.py`, `evaluation_lib.py` and `run_eval.py` is **unmodified**; retained upstream `LICENSE`. Test dataset original `IFBench_test.jsonl` has its own **ODC-BY-1.0** data licence, per upstream README, research/educational purpose and third-party generated data terms. For privacy, original 60 selected prompt texts and complete model-generated answers remain only in Tang ignored `results/stage44_ifbench_source/` and `results/stage44_ifbench_external60/`. Public GitHub only stores source hashes and per-prompt official booleans.

Dependences `emoji`, `syllapy`, `nltk`, `immutabledict`, `langdetect` and related libraries installed in isolated Tang venv. Genuine NLTK `punkt`/`punkt_tab`/`stopwords`/`averaged_perceptron_tagger_eng` resources installed locally with verified original source Git blob SHA-1; the evaluator code and scoring rules have not been changed. The NLTK corpus folder is owner-only (not world-writable) and excluded from Git.
